svg.title: Recover from a late segment without moving the timeline

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(245, 247, 250), rgb(24, 25, 28)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(168, 185, 199), rgb(68, 83, 95));

g.text: Recover from a late segment without moving the timeline
Example: segment 0 played; segment 1 misses its start. Segment 3 is the earliest with enough preparation time.

path.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(35, 68, 93), rgb(160, 188, 210)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(35, 68, 93), rgb(160, 188, 210));

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(224, 240, 223), rgb(25, 39, 25)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(71, 118, 67), rgb(119, 159, 115));
fill: light-dark(rgb(248, 223, 220), rgb(58, 37, 34)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(166, 80, 73), rgb(211, 137, 131));

path.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(35, 68, 93), rgb(160, 188, 210)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(35, 68, 93), rgb(160, 188, 210));

g.text: Select earliest segment with scheduled tick ≥ current tick + preparation budget.
Recheck readiness at its tick; skip again if needed. If no segment qualifies, discard the remaining parent.
The gap remains at its original sample positions. All channels advance together.

path.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(35, 68, 93), rgb(160, 188, 210)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(35, 68, 93), rgb(160, 188, 210));

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(219, 230, 240), rgb(32, 42, 50)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(35, 68, 93), rgb(160, 188, 210));

g.text: One parent completion: requested = 6K, transmitted = 4K, skipped = 2K, late flag set.
